name: Silt
description: The finest grade: pinhead dots settling over a ground ruled in both directions.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; @size: calc(@rand(4px, 16px) * 6 / @size-col); -webkit-transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @random(0.5) { -webkit-box-shadow: -1px 0 0 @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-shadow: -1px 0 0 @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
